form_number.description: FEMA form number printed in the page footer, e.g. FF-206-FY-22-152.

property.description: Section A: the building being certified.

street_address.description: A2. Building street address, without city, state or ZIP.

property_description.description: A3. Property description (lot and block, legal description) and/or tax parcel number, as printed.

building_use.description: A4. Building use, e.g. Residential or Non-Residential.

longitude.description: A5. Longitude in decimal degrees (negative west of Greenwich).

horizontal_datum.description: A5. The checked horizontal datum: NAD 1927, NAD 1983 or WGS 84.

crawlspace_square_footage.description: A8.a. Square footage of crawlspace or enclosure(s).

attached_garage_square_footage.description: A9.a. Square footage of attached garage.

firm.description: Section B: Flood Insurance Rate Map (FIRM) information.

firm_index_date.description: B6. FIRM index date, as YYYY-MM-DD.

firm_panel_effective_date.description: B7. FIRM panel effective/revised date, as YYYY-MM-DD.

base_flood_elevation.description: B9. Base flood elevation (BFE), or base flood depth in Zone AO.

bfe_source.description: B10. The checked source of the BFE: FIS, FIRM, Community Determined or Other.

bfe_vertical_datum.description: B11. The checked elevation datum for the BFE, e.g. NAVD 1988.

in_cbrs_or_opa.description: B12. Whether the building is in a Coastal Barrier Resources System area or Otherwise Protected Area.

seaward_of_limwa.description: B13. Whether the building is seaward of the Limit of Moderate Wave Action.

elevations.description: Section C: building elevation information from the survey.

construction_status.description: C1. The checked basis for the elevations: Construction Drawings, Building Under Construction or Finished Construction.

vertical_datum.description: C2. Vertical datum used for the elevations, e.g. NAVD 1988.

unit.description: The checked measurement unit for the elevations: feet or meters.

top_of_bottom_floor.description: C2.a. Top of bottom floor (including basement, crawlspace or enclosure floor). If no number is written on this line, return null: a blank line is not zero.

top_of_next_higher_floor.description: C2.b. Top of the next higher floor. If no number is written on this line, return null: a blank line is not zero.

bottom_of_lowest_horizontal_structural_m.description: C2.c. Bottom of the lowest horizontal structural member. If no number is written on this line, return null: a blank line is not zero.

attached_garage_top_of_slab.description: C2.d. Attached garage (top of slab). If no number is written on this line, return null: a blank line is not zero.

lowest_machinery_and_equipment.description: C2.e. Lowest elevation of machinery and equipment servicing the building. If no number is written on this line, return null: a blank line is not zero.

lowest_adjacent_grade.description: C2.f. Lowest adjacent grade (LAG) next to the building. If no number is written on this line, return null: a blank line is not zero.

highest_adjacent_grade.description: C2.g. Highest adjacent grade (HAG) next to the building. If no number is written on this line, return null: a blank line is not zero.

certification.description: Section D: the surveyor, engineer or architect certification.

certification_date.description: Date beside the signature line, as YYYY-MM-DD.

lat_long_by_licensed_surveyor.description: Whether the Section A latitude and longitude were provided by a licensed land surveyor.

photographs.description: Building photographs on the photo pages: one entry per photograph actually inserted, in page order. Do not include an empty photo slot (a label with no photograph and no caption).

caption.description: Caption printed beside the photo, or null if the caption line is blank.
